review_kind: Phase 0 contract/threat matrix for ADR-0148 v3 (rewrite after v2's C-1 and M-1..M-4)

supersedes.changed_approach: C-1: the hop retries an ATTEMPT, not a stream -- the intent gains an `attempt` field, a read-only derivation_head accessor is added, and an ascending-scan orchestrator contract makes idempotence real; abandoned PRODUCED/SEALED attempts are disclosed as permanently unresumable because _reload_stream restores only _streams. M-1: DP6's compose_replay_tape analogy withdrawn; writer signature hard-constrained to verified raw-event/v2 bytes plus verified roster policy. M-2: hop 1 -> dynamic resolver, hop 3 -> fixed resolver, both named. M-3: bundles.py imports the trust-side shape table instead of keeping its own constant. M-4: durability scoped explicitly to the development broker; operational durability named an open gate.

actors.dataset_capture_broker: DatasetCaptureAuthorization.v2 + its own one-use G1/G2; key table _SYNTHETIC_GRANT_PUBLIC_KEYS (trust.py:5635). The only actor performing a source provider/filesystem/network read.
actors.lifecycle_authority: Owns PRODUCED->SEALED->PUBLISHED->CAPTURED->CONSUMED, session kinds, port derivation, receipt issuance, CapturedPortSet minting/interning, the derivation-hop and the replay-execution entry.
actors.durable_store_owner: A production/-side caller owning a ChainLedger-backed mapping adapter, injected via receipt_store. dskit/pipeline imports nothing from dskit/production.
actors.envelope_writer: production/bundles.py. Owns envelope shape/canonical bytes/ordering; passed INTO the hop as a strategy. Never imported by trust.py.
actors.hostile: Code with full interpreter control in-process. Mutable Python internals are NOT an external security boundary (implementation-workflow.md step 4); the claim is the interning/opaque-handle boundary.

invariants.invariant: At most ONE PUBLISHED root per derivation intent; stream_id is a pure function of derivation_intent_sha256 (which includes `attempt`).
input_families: intent not equal to ports actually consumed
retry under a different consumer session run_identity
retry after an attempt already PUBLISHED
invariants.expected: refuse before produce; a PUBLISHED attempt is REUSED and never re-produced; the ceiling refuses
invariants.forbidden_effect: two PUBLISHED roots for one intent

invariants.invariant: The crash story matches the code: the hop retries an attempt, never a stream, and idempotence comes from the orchestrator's ascending scan.
input_families: mixed: attempt 0 SEALED and attempt 1 absent
invariants.expected: absent -> produce there; PRODUCED/SEALED -> skipped as abandoned and NEVER resumed (disclosed); PUBLISHED -> reuse and stop; with the default {} store no durability is claimed and RED asserts none is made
invariants.forbidden_effect: any claim that produce() resumes a crashed stream; any dskit.pipeline -> dskit.production import

invariants.invariant: ReplayRun.run refuses identically; only the broker entry executes.
input_families: a V1 CapturedBindings offered in place of a port set
invariants.expected: unchanged RuntimeError on ordinary paths; intern-check refusal on every forged set; success ONLY on a broker-minted V2 port set
invariants.forbidden_effect: execution reachable without a broker-minted set; any weakening of the existing refusal

invariants.invariant: Ranks derive only from the verified pre-document roster policy over the complete authorized source universe.
input_families: event whose source_id is not in the roster
invariants.expected: zero-event source keeps its rank; every other family refuses before envelope bytes
invariants.forbidden_effect: any policy derived from the resulting tape

invariants.invariant: Every event-envelope/v2 field is projected from authorized captured bytes; no caller supplies envelope metadata.
input_families: v1 member to a v2 authorization
v2 member to a v1 authorization
a bare v1 literal surviving at any of the NINE sites including bundles.py:653
a roster-bootstrap authorization still pinning raw-event/v1 under a v2 wire
invariants.expected: refuse on the literal or closed key set; prior_envelope_sha256 is hop-derived and is not a member field
invariants.forbidden_effect: an unauthorized envelope field reaching a tape; a bare v1 literal surviving at any of the eight sites

invariants.invariant: Chronology is publish -> freeze -> port -> CAPTURED -> session -> CONSUME per hop, with no self-receipt or cycle.
input_families: manifest recording its own root or receipt
dataset grant whose roster digests name NO published roster
invariants.expected: each refuses before the stream, planner or root exists; the exact valid order succeeds; the last family refuses at the hop-1 v2 preflight, NOT at grant issuance
invariants.forbidden_effect: a manifest naming its own root/receipt

invariants.invariant: ReplayRun consumes an exact sorted two-port set over TWO roots; the manifest's inner bytes must agree with the data entry on every named field.
input_families: the two ports naming one root
mismatched root, PUBLISHED members, policy, envelope count, ordered digest list, recomputed tape_digest
inner data_captured_receipt naming the replay port instead of the prior hop-2 port
hop 3 routed through the DYNAMIC resolver (must refuse: hardcoded to hop 1's pair)
the two ports naming one root
invariants.expected: exact-set cardinality checked against document.py:766 before any port object is built; every mismatch refuses before the tape capability is issued
invariants.forbidden_effect: a partially minted set; a tape issued on a disagreeing pair

invariants.invariant: V1 is byte-for-byte unchanged; V2 is a separate primitive on the P4 path.
input_families: V1 second require of the same input
V2 require of each input once
V2 second require of one input
V2 require of an undeclared name
V2 require of tape_data THEN tape_manifest and the reverse order
invariants.expected: V1 messages and cardinality identical to base; V2 consuming one input leaves the other reachable in BOTH orders and neither twice; no stream lifecycle advances until release
invariants.forbidden_effect: any V1 message/cardinality change; the v1 C2 defect recurring

invariants.invariant: CapturedForecastInput accepts only the exact F5a V2 verified set, injected non-serializably at the declared input.
invariants.forbidden_effect: an ambient path or later reconstruction replacing trusted captured input; ANY read/write/subclass/construction of ForecastBundle or ConfirmedCaps by the new path

invariants.invariant: Ordering is availability, derived source rank, source sequence, correction position, payload digest, event ID, stable across restart.
invariants.expected: one stable canonical order; restart reproduces the identical terminal identity
invariants.forbidden_effect: an order depending on input presentation

invariants.invariant: No cross-tier import is introduced in either direction.
input_families: bundles.py gaining a trust symbol import
the envelope writer being called FROM trust rather than passed INTO the hop
invariants.forbidden_effect: the build-order cycle ADR-0145 D5 / ADR-0146 D10 refuse

invariants.invariant: No envelope field can originate from a caller argument: the hop-1 writer has no free-form per-event metadata parameter.
input_families: a writer offered a raw_event_members-shaped metadata argument
a strategy that ignores the verified roster policy
invariants.expected: the signature accepts only verified raw-event/v2 member bytes and the verified roster policy; anything else refuses
invariants.forbidden_effect: recreating compose_replay_tape's unauthorized-metadata defect on the F3 path

non_goals: no E1, C0, A or B lane
no whole-F3 or whole-F5b closure claim from this ADR alone
open_risks: ADR-0147's disclosed limit inherited verbatim: POSIX flock release-on-crash is documented, not proven by code, so F3-I02's cross-process claim is same-machine/same-filesystem only.
The prior Windows-worktree draft was unreachable; findings beyond the five stated in the task are not addressed.
M3's eight-site list was produced by grep over dskit/ at 3b73361 and is asserted exhaustive for these two literals only; Phase 0 must confirm.

v2 N-3 retained: intent-pure stream_id is publicly predictable, so a producer-session holder could pre-empt a stream a legitimate hop will use; producer-session issuance is gated elsewhere. Disclosed, not fixed.
v2 context item retained: _p4_reads (trust.py:5190) per-input read bookkeeping is in-RAM and lost on crash; re-reading immutable WORM bytes is not harmful.
